name: numbers-unit-window-is-two-tokens
description: The unit exception looks at the next two word or number tokens only. After 7 they are "business" and "working", so "days" is out of reach and 7 is skipped although unknown. After 4 they are "more" and "weeks": checked, and unknown (the reference has 6). After 3 the first token is "percent": checked and known. Fires on 4 only.

input.response: Processing takes 7 business working days, 4 more weeks for export, and 3 percent goes to fees.

evidence.text: Exports take 6 weeks. Payment fees are 3 percent.
